description.value: Kagura Hand Roll Bar is a Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on West 4th Avenue, specializing in hand rolls (temaki sushi). It sits along a busy cycling corridor popular with riders heading toward the Arbutus Greenway and foreshore routes. A touring cyclist passing through Kitsilano would find it a compact, likely counter-style spot for a quick Japanese meal.
